title: docs(spec): object_extension registry comment names where objectExtensions really go
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93gC3KXtZJjCp5Vu2rbNZCC)_
Fixes #28855

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `object_extension` 注册行上方的一段 `//` 注释，外加一个 spec patch changeset；不动任何键、行字段或 schema。
- 为什么改：旧注释说"产物加载器把代码包的 `objectExtensions` 存成这个类型的条目"，实测不是：它们经 `registerApp` 注册为 `'extend'` 贡献者，加载器一条也不存。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险（注释不进编译产物）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`（L817–824 注释）、`.changeset/28855-object-extension-registry-comment.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`，应只见注释行变化。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The `//` comment above the `object_extension` row of `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` said a code package's `objectExtensions` are what "the artifact loader already stores under this type name". It now states what the code does:

- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `registerApp` (step 2b, "Register object extensions") registers each `manifest.objectExtensions` entry with `registerObject(..., 'extend', priority)`, as an `'extend'` contributor of its target object.
- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` maps `objectExtensions` to `'object_extension'` in `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE`, but `registerArtifactBodyCollections` skips every item for which `artifactItemSlot` derives no slot, and that slot is the item's `name` (only `view` has a fallback). `ObjectExtensionSchema` is strict, carries `extend` and no `name` (its `name` spelling is a retired alias it refuses), so no `(object_extension, NAME)` item is ever filed from an artifact. `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` (the `RESIDUAL_TYPES_WITH_OWN_PATH` docblock) says the same: an extension has no slot of its own.
- The stored rows of this type are the ones the `/api/v1/meta` doors write since ADR-0146 D10 (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`): stored under the writing package with the target object's name as row name.

Changeset: `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the edited file's published bytes move. A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` is owed, not `skip-changeset`.

No forced test edits.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0 (both under `os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- No ablation: a comment edit changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- The same wrong sentence lives in the header docblock of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` ("`object_extension` is the type the artifact loader already stores a code package's `objectExtensions` under"). Left alone here: it is outside this card's claimed file surface and package. Reported to the seat.
